Privacy notice · October 1, 2026

Who we are

This website introduces Le Biz Brands LLC, based in Miami, Florida. Questions about this notice can be sent to wholesale@lebizbrands.com.

Wholesale inquiries

The contact form prepares a message in your browser. It does not transmit the form fields to us or save them in browser storage. If you choose to send the message using your email app, we receive the information you include, such as your name, business contact details and product introduction.

How we use information

We use information you send to respond to inquiries, assess potential supplier relationships and manage business communications. Please do not send sensitive personal information or banking details in an initial inquiry.

Website technology

We have not added advertising trackers or analytics to this website. The website host and your email provider may process technical information needed to deliver their services, including connection and security logs.

Retention and requests

We keep business correspondence as needed for the relationship and applicable recordkeeping requirements. Contact us to request access, correction or deletion of information you have provided, subject to any retention obligations.

Product imagery

Unbranded product imagery is illustrative. It does not identify current suppliers, endorsements or products offered for sale.
